title: IBM creative review

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Make review part of the production sequence, because a correct-looking application still needs confirmation before release under the guide’s process.
strategic_value: A named review step can help IBM maintain consistent third-party trademark use before materials are distributed.
demonstration: The IBM creative review heading accompanies a single paragraph requiring review before printing or posting and describing a usual response time.
practical_value: Include IBM-contact review before the release step in a third-party communication workflow.

content_islands.name: Review heading
content_islands.spec: Place the short heading in the left column.

content_islands.name: Submission instruction
content_islands.spec: Place the approval requirement and qualified response-time statement in the adjacent narrow text column.

reference_purposes.Application: The page tells users to submit communications to their IBM contact before printing or posting.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Review and approval are required; a response within 24 hours is described as occurring in most cases, not as a guaranteed deadline.
